# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/gen_ucm_realm_actions.py; edit there, not this file.
# Run on a character: bring their laws back to what they have locked.
ucm_law_lock_enforce_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:ucm_law_lock_realm ucm_law_lock_can_realm_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { var:ucm_law_lock_realm ?= flag:confederate_partition_succession_law }
			if = {
				limit = { government_has_flag = government_is_clan }
				if = { limit = {  NOT = { has_realm_law = clan_impassive_partition_succession_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = clan_impassive_partition_succession_law }
			}
			else = { if = { limit = {  NOT = { has_realm_law = confederate_partition_succession_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = confederate_partition_succession_law } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:ucm_law_lock_realm ?= flag:partition_succession_law }
			if = {
				limit = { government_has_flag = government_is_clan }
				if = { limit = {  NOT = { has_realm_law = clan_impassive_partition_succession_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = clan_impassive_partition_succession_law }
			}
			else = { if = { limit = {  NOT = { has_realm_law = partition_succession_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = partition_succession_law } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:ucm_law_lock_realm ?= flag:high_partition_succession_law }
			if = {
				limit = { government_has_flag = government_is_clan }
				if = { limit = {  NOT = { has_realm_law = clan_friendly_partition_succession_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = clan_friendly_partition_succession_law }
			}
			else = { if = { limit = {  NOT = { has_realm_law = high_partition_succession_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = high_partition_succession_law } }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:ucm_law_lock_realm ?= flag:single_heir_succession_law NOT = { has_realm_law = single_heir_succession_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = single_heir_succession_law }
		if = { limit = { var:ucm_law_lock_realm ?= flag:single_heir_succession_law_youngest NOT = { has_realm_law = single_heir_succession_law_youngest } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = single_heir_succession_law_youngest }
		if = { limit = { var:ucm_law_lock_realm ?= flag:single_heir_dynasty_house NOT = { has_realm_law = single_heir_dynasty_house } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = single_heir_dynasty_house }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:ucm_law_lock_gender ucm_law_lock_can_gender_trigger = yes }
		if = { limit = { var:ucm_law_lock_gender ?= flag:male_only_law NOT = { has_realm_law = male_only_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = male_only_law }
		if = { limit = { var:ucm_law_lock_gender ?= flag:male_preference_law NOT = { has_realm_law = male_preference_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = male_preference_law }
		if = { limit = { var:ucm_law_lock_gender ?= flag:equal_law NOT = { has_realm_law = equal_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = equal_law }
		if = { limit = { var:ucm_law_lock_gender ?= flag:female_preference_law NOT = { has_realm_law = female_preference_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = female_preference_law }
		if = { limit = { var:ucm_law_lock_gender ?= flag:female_only_law NOT = { has_realm_law = female_only_law } } add_realm_law_skip_effects = female_only_law }
	}
}

# Lock LAW on this character. GROUP is realm or gender; a new pick overwrites the group's variable.
ucm_law_lock_set_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = ucm_law_lock_$GROUP$ value = flag:$LAW$ }
	ucm_law_lock_enforce_effect = yes
}

# Root = player, this = target. Applies to the target's vassals too while the player has the toggle on.
ucm_law_pick_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { ucm_law_lock_can_$GROUP$_trigger = yes }
		ucm_law_lock_set_effect = { GROUP = $GROUP$ LAW = $LAW$ }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { has_character_flag = ucm_law_include_vassals } }
		every_vassal_or_below = {
			limit = { ucm_law_lock_can_$GROUP$_trigger = yes }
			ucm_law_lock_set_effect = { GROUP = $GROUP$ LAW = $LAW$ }
		}
	}
}

ucm_law_lock_clear_effect = {
	remove_variable = ucm_law_lock_realm
	remove_variable = ucm_law_lock_gender
}
